name: Moderna
description: Moderna develops vaccines and medicines built on messenger RNA and currently earns essentially all its revenue from one product family, its COVID-19 vaccines (Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE), plus a small RSV vaccine (mRESVIA). Revenue fell from $19.3 billion in 2022 to $1.9 billion in 2025 as COVID demand faded, while spending on research ($3.1 billion in 2025) kept it deeply loss-making (net loss $2.8 billion). It sells to wholesalers and pharmacies in the US and to governments abroad under advance purchase and long-term agreements. A seasonal flu vaccine (mFLUSIVA, mRNA-1010) was approved by the FDA on 2026-08-05 and is the next product launch; the company says it plans to cut costs further in 2026 and 2027.

businessLines.name: COVID-19 vaccines (Spikevax, mNEXSPIKE)
businessLines.how: Sells doses per season to wholesalers, pharmacies and governments at a price per dose; revenue depends on how many people get vaccinated each autumn and on government purchase contracts, so it is seasonal and falls when COVID demand falls. Company-wide, the business loses money at this volume.
businessLines.description: mRNA COVID-19 vaccines for adults and children; mNEXSPIKE was approved by the FDA in May 2025 for people 65 and older and high-risk people 12 to 64.

revenue.note: Net product sales; FY2024 3,084; FY2023 6,671. Decline from lower volumes in all regions and completion of European advance purchase agreements.

businessLines.revenueNote: Net product sales; FY2024 3,084; FY2023 6,671. Decline from lower volumes in all regions and completion of European advance purchase agreements.

businessLines.name: RSV vaccine (mRESVIA)
businessLines.how: Per-dose vaccine sales as above; negligible so far against Pfizer's and GSK's earlier RSV vaccines.
businessLines.description: RSV vaccine approved by the FDA in May 2024 for adults 60 and older (also high-risk adults 18-59 approved in 31 countries).

whatsNext.text: Launch of mFLUSIVA seasonal influenza vaccine ahead of the 2026-2027 respiratory season; the FDA approved it on 2026-08-05 (full approval ages 50-64, accelerated approval 65+ with a postmarketing study). Moderna expects supply at select retailers before the season.
